the impact of physical health and breastfeeding problems on the mental health of mothers.
the impact of maternal physical health, breastfeeding problems, and their co-occurrence, on maternal mood (depressive, anxiety, fatigue and irritability) in the early postnatal period.
the relationship between breastfeeding problems and maternal physical health problems in the early post-partum.

women who have a high burden of health problems in the early postnatal period are at increased risk of poor maternal mood.
